title: Mishy Mish Mash
style: Pop-rap sports commentary duet with punchy bounce and clipped call-and-response rhythms; verse rides fast play-by-play over handclaps and stomps, pre-chorus strips to tense vocal stacks and a ticking pulse, chorus hits with gang shouts and doubled hook lines. Twin lead vocals trade lines with ad-lib echoes, quick delay throws on key names, whistle hits and crowd-chant risers between phrases, bright punchy mix with a live-broadcast edge.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Live on the line, it’s Michelle
Mishy mishy mish mash, what a spell
Look at that stance, look at that eyes
Lock in the court, don’t blink, don’t slide

[Pre-Chorus]
Focus now
Hold that breath
Read the bounce
Then swing clean

[Chorus]
Michelle, Michelle, lock in
Bull smash, bull smash, win
Reset perfect, every shot
Like a machine, hit the spot
Michelle, Michelle, lock in
No fall, no fold, no slip

[Verse 2]
She was pro tennis, that’s the truth
Fast as a flash in her youth
Then life clipped hard, big black truck
Out of luck? Nah, still got guts

Now it’s paddle, angle, spin
Tennis to pickleball, let her in
She don’t chase, she makes you run
One more stop and the point is done

[Pre-Chorus]
Focus now
Hands are still
See the gap
Take the kill

[Chorus]
Michelle, Michelle, lock in
Bull smash, bull smash, win
Reset perfect, every shot
Like a machine, hit the spot
Michelle, Michelle, lock in
No fall, no fold, no slip

[Bridge]
Commentary says, “Watch that turn”
Commentary says, “Feel that burn”
She stops, she sets, she sends it back
Clean on the line, no wasted track

[Final Chorus]
Michelle, Michelle, lock in
Bull smash, bull smash, win
Reset perfect, every shot
Like a machine, hit the spot
Michelle, Michelle, lock in
Tennis to pickleball, no fall
